I doubt they'll need to include anything on what Black Hand means - I
expect it'll be a designation that only matters to other cards, like
"Ghoul" or "Wraith". Since they are claiming that there are no new
rules to discuss, I think it's very likely that Seraph is *not*
inherently worth votes, but merely an even smaller category of
designation - I expect we'll see some 'only usable by a Seraph' cards,
or perhaps 'this card does x, and also does y if you're a seraph'.

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body:
"Orpheus" <orph...@NOSPAMfree.fr> wrote in message news:<3fa196e2$0$241$636a...@news.free.fr>...

> I don't like Manga in general ; but I especially find it unappropriate for

> type, whether manga, super-hero, Warner Bros or whatever (on the other hand,
> Gangrel Coyote chasing Malkavian Roadrunner would be a treat... No, please
> don't, I was kidding !!! ;)

I really, really like the manga art, *because it has been on appropriate
cards*. At least thus far. Sure, the game is modern Gothic in tone, but how
the hell do you portray a modern Gothic fight? Goths don't fight. Given that
all the manga-style stuff I can think of OTOH has been for combat cards
(Diversion, Shakar, one of the Holds), I think it's entirely fitting. I
would have a problem if some of the crypt portraits were manga-style, but
I'm all for the new art as long as it's appropriate to what the cards is/does.

Kushiel
